show.description: When city girl Shefali steps into a dangerous jungle, she faces Garudaa - a fierce warrior who rules with power and passion. What starts with fear turns into fire, love, and revenge. Wild Secrets 🔥 is a bold saga of lust, loyalty, and survival - where ancient rituals clash with modern instincts in a world ruled by desire.
